dedupe_keys.name: esa earth online earth observation data gateway

description: Earth Online is the European Space Agency's gateway to its Earth observation missions and data. Its data section lets users discover and download products from the catalogue of missions that ESA operates and supports, with mission pages for Aeolus, Biomass, CryoSat, SMOS and Swarm and a list of all other collections for ESA and Third Party Missions, plus a feed of the latest data releases (for example Swarm Level 2 processor updates and new campaign datasets). It points to three wider catalogues: the Multi-mission Algorithm and Analysis Platform (MAAP) explorer, the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem for Sentinel data, and FedEO, a single entry point to several scientific catalogues. Requests, proposals and profiles are handled through the ESA EO User Portal. Access conditions and licences differ by mission and collection and are given on each collection page. Caveat: Earth Online is an entry point, not a single dataset, and many products need registration. It is a starting point for finding satellite imagery and derived products (ice, soil moisture, geomagnetic field from Swarm) used for hazard exposure and monitoring of infrastructure regions; it complements the mission-specific records in this catalogue.
